title: sourceReader
responsibility: Owns revision-bound archived source access, category paths, selection, loading, errors and cancellation.

inputs.name: archivedSource.unit
inputs.description: The selected revision’s owned files and source snapshots.

inputs.name: archivedSource.mediaBase
inputs.description: The host-controlled media address for this revision.

inputs.name: archivedSource.filePath
inputs.description: Optional owned path to select first.

inputs.name: implementationFiles.unit
inputs.description: A source-owning unit with optional responsibility category.

outputs.name: createSourceReaderStore
outputs.description: Returns reactive state plus initialise, select and cancel. Each selection clears prior contents and errors; superseded or disposed reads cannot overwrite the current session.

outputs.name: implementationFiles
outputs.description: Category implementation paths, preserving recorded paths for older revisions and framework entries.

outputs.name: archivedSource
outputs.type: { files: SourceFiles; read: SourceRead; empty?: string }
outputs.description: Reads only archived committed text; missing source is an explicit gap and never uses a working copy.
